App::Greple::tee - module to replace matched text by the external command result
App::Greple::tee - 用外部命令结果替换匹配文本的模块
Greple's B<-Mtee> module sends the matched parts of the text to the given filter command, and replaces them with the result of the command. The idea is derived from the command called B<teip>. It is like passing only a part of the data through an external filter command.
Greple 的 B<-Mtee> 模块将匹配到的文本片段发送给指定的过滤命令，并用该命令的结果替换。这个想法源自名为 B<teip> 的命令。它就像把部分数据旁路到外部过滤命令。
The filter command follows the module declaration (C<-Mtee>) and ends with two dashes (C<-->). For example, the next command calls the C<tr> command with the arguments C<a-z A-Z> for the matched words in the data.
过滤命令紧跟在模块声明（C<-Mtee>）之后，并以两个短横线（C<-->）结束。例如，下面的命令对数据中匹配到的单词调用 C<tr> 命令，并传入 C<a-z A-Z> 参数。
The above command converts all the matched words from lower case to upper case. This example itself is not so useful, because B<greple> can do the same thing more efficiently with the B<--cm> option.
上面的命令把所有匹配到的单词从小写转换为大写。事实上，这个例子本身不太实用，因为 B<greple> 使用 B<--cm> 选项可以更高效地完成同样的事情。
By default, the command is executed as a single process, and all the matched data is sent to it together. If the matched text does not end with a newline, one is added before sending and removed after receiving. Input and output data are mapped line by line, so the number of lines of input and output must be identical.
默认情况下，命令作为单个进程执行，所有匹配到的数据混合后发送到该进程。如果匹配文本不以换行结束，会在发送前补加换行并在接收后去除。输入与输出数据按行对应，因此输入与输出的行数必须相同。
With the B<--discrete> option, the command is called separately for each matched area. You can see the difference with the following commands.
使用 B<--discrete> 选项时，会为每个匹配的文本区域单独调用命令。你可以通过以下命令分辨差异。
With the B<--discrete> option, the number of lines of input and output does not have to be the same.
与 B<--discrete> 选项一起使用时，输入与输出数据的行数不必相同。
Invokes a new command for each matched part.
为每个匹配到的部分单独启动新命令。
With the B<--discrete> option, the command for each match is executed when the match is output. The B<--bulkmode> option executes all of them at once before the output.
使用 B<--discrete> 选项时，每个匹配项的命令会在输出匹配项时执行。B<--bulkmode> 选项会在输出前一次性执行所有命令。
This option has no effect in the new form of L</MULTIPLE FILTERS>, where the filters are always executed for all the matches at once.
在 L</MULTIPLE FILTERS> 的新形式中，此选项无效，因为筛选器始终会一次性对所有匹配项执行。
This option replaces all newline characters in the middle of each block with carriage return characters. Carriage returns contained in the result of executing the command are converted back to newline characters. Thus, blocks consisting of multiple lines can be processed in batches without using the B<--discrete> option.
该选项会将每个块中间的所有换行符替换为回车符。执行命令得到的结果中包含的回车符会还原为换行符。这样就可以在不使用 B<--discrete> 选项的情况下批量处理由多行组成的块。
This works well with the B<--crmode> option of the L<ansifold> command, which joins CR-separated text and outputs folded lines separated by CR.
这与 L<ansifold> 命令的 B<--crmode> 选项配合良好，该选项将以 CR 分隔的文本合并，并输出以 CR 分隔的折行。
Combines a sequence of non-blank lines into a single line before passing them to the filter command. Newline characters between full-width characters (Japanese, Chinese) are deleted, and other newline characters are replaced with spaces. Korean (Hangul) is treated like ASCII text and joined with spaces.
在传给过滤命令之前，将连续的非空行合并为一行。全角字符（中文、日文）之间的换行会被删除，其他换行会被替换为空格。韩文（谚文/Hangul）按 ASCII 文本处理，以空格连接。
Combines two or more consecutive newline characters into one.
将两个或更多连续的换行合并为一个。
Executes a function given by C<&function> in the B<greple> process itself, without forking (see L</FUNCTION CALL>). This is the default. Use B<--no-nofork> to execute it in a forked child process. This option has no effect on external commands.
在 B<greple> 进程本身中执行由 C<&function> 指定的函数，而不创建子进程（参见 L</FUNCTION CALL>）。这是默认设置。使用 B<--no-nofork> 可在创建的子进程中执行它。此选项对外部命令无效。
The equivalent of the B<--offload> option of L<teip(1)> is provided by another module, L<App::Greple::L> (B<-ML>).
L<teip(1)> 的 B<--offload> 选项的等效功能由另一个模块 L<App::Greple::L>（B<-ML>）提供。
You can also use the B<-ML> module to process only even-numbered lines as follows.
你也可以使用 B<-ML> 模块如下只处理偶数行。
You can give B<-Mtee> more than once, each with its own patterns and filter. Each filter is applied to the patterns given with it.
可以多次指定 B<-Mtee>，每次都有自己的模式和过滤器。每个过滤器都应用于与其一起指定的模式。
Everything before the first non-option argument is an option of the module, and the rest up to C<--> is the command. For example, the next command folds the lines that match C<PAT1> or C<PAT2> with B<ansifold>, and formats the lines that match C<PAT3> as a table with B<ansicolumn>.
第一个非选项参数之前的所有内容都是模块选项，其余直到 C<--> 为止的是命令。例如，以下命令使用 B<ansifold> 折叠匹配 C<PAT1> 或 C<PAT2> 的行，并使用 B<ansicolumn> 将匹配 C<PAT3> 的行格式化为表格。
There are two forms.
有两种形式。
When there is no pattern inside B<-Mtee>, the command is applied to all the patterns that follow C<-->, as before. If it is given more than once, the last one takes effect.
当 B<-Mtee> 中没有模式时，命令会像以前一样应用于 C<--> 之后的所有模式。如果给出多次，则最后一个生效。
When there is a pattern inside B<-Mtee>, the command is applied only to the patterns in that B<-Mtee>.
当 B<-Mtee> 中有模式时，命令只应用于该 B<-Mtee> 中的模式。
Mixing the two forms is an error. A B<-Mtee> with nothing before C<-->, such as the first half of C<-Mtee::config(...) -Mtee ...>, only sets the configuration and counts as neither form.
混用这两种形式会导致错误。C<--> 之前没有任何内容的 B<-Mtee>，例如 C<-Mtee::config(...) -Mtee ...> 的前半部分，只设置配置，且不属于任何一种形式。
The errors are detected when the first file is searched, before any output.
错误会在搜索第一个文件时、任何输出之前被检测到。
Modes of the filter. They can be negated with the B<--no-> form, such as B<--no-crmode>.
过滤器的模式。可使用 B<--no-> 形式将其否定，例如 B<--no-crmode>。
Regular expression pattern.
正则表达式模式。
Pattern. It is taken as one pattern even if it includes spaces.
模式。即使包含空格，也会被视为一个模式。
Fixed string pattern.
固定字符串模式。
A single keyword, or a C<&function>. Giving several keywords separated by spaces is an error.
单个关键字，或一个 C<&function>。给出多个以空格分隔的关键字会导致错误。
Passed to B<greple> as is. The color is not bound to the pattern but is assigned to the pattern numbers cyclically in the order specified (see L</LIMITATIONS>).
原样传递给 B<greple>。颜色不绑定到模式，而是按指定顺序循环分配给模式编号（参见 L</LIMITATIONS>）。
An option provided by B<Getopt::EX::Config>. It changes the setting common to B<all> the filters.
由 B<Getopt::EX::Config> 提供的一个选项。它会更改 B<所有> 过滤器共用的设置。
Giving other options, such as B<--exclude>, is an error. Write them after C<-->; they apply to all the filters.
给出其他选项（如 B<--exclude>）会导致错误。请将它们写在 C<--> 之后；它们会应用于所有过滤器。
The value of a mode is decided at run time in the following order.
模式的值在运行时按以下顺序决定。
The one specified inside B<-Mtee> (B<--crmode>, B<--no-crmode>).
在 B<-Mtee> 内指定的值（B<--crmode>、B<--no-crmode>）。
The one specified after C<-->, or by B<-Mtee::config(...)>.
在 C<--> 之后指定的值，或由 B<-Mtee::config(...)> 指定的值。
In the new form, B<--need=1> is added automatically, so that a block which includes any one of the patterns is processed (OR). Specify B<--need> after C<--> to override it; B<--need=2> brings back AND. The legacy form works as before (AND). Each B<-Mtee>, and each alias option that includes B<-Mtee>, adds B<--need=1> again, so put B<--need> after all of them.
在新形式中，会自动添加 B<--need=1>，因此会处理包含任一模式的块（OR）。在 C<--> 之后指定 B<--need> 可覆盖它；B<--need=2> 会恢复 AND。旧形式仍按原来的方式工作（AND）。每个 B<-Mtee> 以及每个包含 B<-Mtee> 的别名选项都会再次添加 B<--need=1>，因此请将 B<--need> 放在它们全部之后。
If the command is omitted (C<-Mtee -E PAT -->), the pattern selects text but the text is not changed.
如果省略命令（C<-Mtee -E PAT -->），模式会选择文本，但不会更改文本。
In the new form, a pattern outside B<-Mtee> is an error. So is B<--callback> outside B<-Mtee>.
在新形式中，B<-Mtee> 外的模式会导致错误。B<-Mtee> 外的 B<--callback> 也是如此。
In the new form, the first argument after C<--> is not taken as a pattern even if it is meant as one, because the patterns are already given by options. B<greple> takes it as a file name.
在新形式中，C<--> 之后的第一个参数即使本意是模式，也不会被视为模式，因为模式已通过选项给出。B<greple> 会将其视为文件名。
When the matches of different filters overlap, B<greple> merges them into one area and the filter of the match which starts first is applied.
当不同过滤器的匹配区域重叠时，B<greple> 会将它们合并为一个区域，并应用最先开始的匹配所对应的过滤器。
C<{DEFINE}> written directly inside B<-Mtee> on the command line is not expanded. It is expanded inside an B<option> definition.
直接在命令行的 B<-Mtee> 内编写的 C<{DEFINE}> 不会展开。在 B<option> 定义内则会展开。
No other option can be written between B<-Mtee> modules, because B<-M> must be at the head of the arguments. Use an alias option to combine B<-Mtee> modules and other options.
不能在 B<-Mtee> 模块之间写入其他选项，因为 B<-M> 必须位于参数开头。使用别名选项将 B<-Mtee> 模块与其他选项组合。
C<--> cannot be included in the command arguments, as before.
与以前一样，命令参数中不能包含 C<-->。
B<--cm> is not independent for each filter. If it is specified for only some patterns, the colors of other patterns, including those in other B<-Mtee>, change because of the cyclic assignment by B<greple>. Specify B<--cm> for all the patterns when specifying colors.
B<--cm> 并非对每个过滤器独立。如果仅为部分模式指定它，包括其他 B<-Mtee> 中的模式在内的其他模式颜色会因 B<greple> 的循环分配而改变。指定颜色时，请为所有模式指定 B<--cm>。
When another module follows B<-Mtee> (C<-Mtee -E PAT cmd -- -Mcolors>), the patterns are passed to B<greple> through the B<default> option of the module, and the expansion of the option definition, such as C<$ENV{NAME}> and C<__PACKAGE__>, applies to them. They are not escaped.
当另一个模块位于 B<-Mtee> 之后时（C<-Mtee -E PAT cmd -- -Mcolors>），模式会通过该模块的 B<default> 选项传递给 B<greple>，并且选项定义中的扩展（如 C<$ENV{NAME}> 和 C<__PACKAGE__>）会应用于这些模式。它们不会被转义。
Suppose there is a module whose B<default> option includes a new form B<-Mtee>. If it is loaded before a B<-Mtee> which is followed by another module, as in C<-Mfoo -Mtee -E PAT cmd -- -Mcolors>, the patterns are lost. This is detected as an error ("passed twice or lost"). Load such a module after B<-Mtee>.
假设存在某个 B<default> 选项包含新形式 B<-Mtee> 的模块。如果它在 B<-Mtee> 后跟另一个模块之前加载，例如 C<-Mfoo -Mtee -E PAT cmd -- -Mcolors>，模式会丢失。这会被检测为错误（“重复传递或丢失”）。请在 B<-Mtee> 之后加载此类模块。

模块参数可使用 B<Getopt::EX::Config> 模块按以下语法设置：
This is useful when combined with shell aliases or module files.
这在与 shell 别名或模块文件结合时很有用。
Available parameters are: B<discrete>, B<bulkmode>, B<crmode>, B<fillup>, B<squeeze>, B<nofork>.
可用参数有：B<discrete>、B<bulkmode>、B<crmode>、B<fillup>、B<squeeze>、B<nofork>。
Instead of an external command, you can call a Perl function by prefixing the command name with C<&>.
您可以通过在命令名前加上 C<&> 来调用 Perl 函数，而不是外部命令。
The function must follow these requirements:
该函数必须遵循以下要求：
Read the matched text from B<STDIN>
从 B<STDIN> 读取匹配的文本
Print the converted result to B<STDOUT>
将转换后的结果打印到 B<STDOUT>
Arguments are passed via both C<@ARGV> and C<@_>
参数通过 C<@ARGV> 和 C<@_> 同时传递
By default, the function is executed in the B<greple> process itself, without forking. So, the values of global variables changed by the function remain in the next call, and calling B<exit> in the function terminates B<greple>. With the B<--no-nofork> option, the function is executed in a forked child process.
默认情况下，函数在 B<greple> 进程本身中执行，不会 fork。因此，函数更改的全局变量值会保留到下一次调用，并且在函数中调用 B<exit> 会终止 B<greple>。使用 B<--no-nofork> 选项时，函数会在 fork 出来的子进程中执行。
Any fully qualified function name can be used:
可以使用任何完全限定的函数名：
The module is automatically loaded if not already loaded.
如果模块尚未加载，将自动加载。
For convenience, the following short aliases are available:
为方便起见，提供以下简短别名：
Calls C<App::ansicolumn::ansicolumn>.
调用 C<App::ansicolumn::ansicolumn>。
Calls C<App::ansifold::ansifold>.
调用 C<App::ansifold::ansifold>。
Calls C<App::cat::v-E<gt>new-E<gt>run(@_)>.
调用 C<App::cat::v-E<gt>new-E<gt>run(@_)>。
Using a function call avoids the overhead of starting an external process for each invocation, which can significantly improve performance when used with the B<--discrete> option.
使用函数调用可避免每次调用都启动外部进程所带来的开销，当与 B<--discrete> 选项一起使用时，可显著提升性能。
The B<--blocks> option has been removed. It is no longer needed now that the B<--stretch> (B<-S>) option has been implemented in B<greple>. Use the following instead.
B<--blocks> 选项已被移除。由于 B<greple> 中已实现 B<--stretch>（B<-S>）选项，它已不再需要。请改用以下方式。
First of all, whenever you can do it with the B<teip> command, use it. It is an excellent tool and much faster than B<greple>.
首先，只要可以用 B<teip> 命令做到，就用它。它是一个优秀且比 B<greple> 快得多的工具。
Because B<greple> is designed to process document files, it has many features that are appropriate for it, such as match area controls. It might be worth using B<greple> to take advantage of those features.
由于 B<greple> 旨在处理文档文件，它具有许多适用于此目的的功能，例如匹配区域控制。为了利用这些功能，使用 B<greple> 也许是值得的。
Also, B<teip> cannot handle multiple lines of data as a single unit, while B<greple> can execute individual commands on a data chunk consisting of multiple lines.
此外，B<teip> 不能将多行数据作为一个单元处理，而 B<greple> 可以对由多行组成的数据块执行单独的命令。

下面的命令将会在包含于 Perl 模块文件中的 L<perlpod(1)> 风格文档里查找文本区块。

不过，专用模块 L<App::Greple::xlate::deepl> 在此目的上更有效。实际上，B<tee> 模块的实现提示来自 B<xlate> 模块。
The next command finds some indented parts in the LICENSE document.
下面的命令将在 LICENSE 文档中找到一些缩进部分。

你可以用带有 B<ansifold> 命令的 B<tee> 模块来重新格式化这些部分。两个 B<--crmode> 选项一起使用可以高效处理多行区块：
The B<--discrete> option can also be used but will start multiple processes, so it takes longer to execute.
B<--discrete> 选项也可以使用，但会启动多个进程，因此执行时间更长。

考虑一种情况：你想从表头以外的行中 grep 字符串。例如，你可能想在 C<docker image ls> 命令的输出中搜索 Docker 镜像名称，但保留表头行。可以用下面的命令实现。
The option C<-ML 2:> takes the lines from the second line to the end, and sends them to the C<grep perl> command. The option B<--discrete> is required because the number of lines changes, but since the command is executed only once, there is no performance drawback.
选项 C<-ML 2:> 取出从第二行到末尾的内容，并将其发送到 C<grep perl> 命令。由于行数发生变化，需要使用 B<--discrete> 选项，但因为命令只执行一次，所以没有性能上的劣势。
If you try to do the same thing with the B<teip> command, C<teip -l 2- -- grep> will give an error because the number of output lines is less than the number of input lines, although the output itself is correct.
如果尝试用 B<teip> 命令做同样的事情，C<teip -l 2- -- grep> 会报错，因为输出行数少于输入行数，尽管输出结果本身是正确的。
